title: go-udx: acknowledge PINGs sent under a nonzero sequence
description: Next up (before Phase 5). go-udx never ACKs PING-only packets (not data-bearing), so dart-udx ping() and js-udx ping()/PMTUD probes always fail against Go; dart-libp2p's relayed-connection health check then waits 5 s and falls back to a test stream. Fix in ../go-udx on a branch: in Connection.HandlePacket, treat a packet with a PING frame and Sequence != 0 as ack-eliciting (immediate ACK via noteReceived with edge=true); keep seq-0 PINGs (go-udx's own control packets) unacknowledged so ACKs never elicit ACKs. Mirror js-udx connection.ts handlePacket rule. Add go tests; then js-udx go-interop test 'ping resolves false against Go' and 'datagramSize stays 1418' must flip (ping true; PMTUD rises to 1472). Merge locally, don't push.
close_reason: go-udx fix/ack-pings (7867fb6, merged 92446f8, not pushed): numbered PINGs/probes recorded and ACKed at once; seq-0 PINGs unacked. go tests in ack_policy_test.go; js-udx go-interop now asserts ping()=true and PMTUD=1472 (fails against pre-fix go-udx).

Still open for go-udx: RTO formula, collapsed RTO timer, ssthresh 65535, stale v2 cmd/interop-server, PENDING_WORK §5, flaky dead-path test (see notes).
